Package neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.piping

Class PipeStressModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mechanicaldesign.piping.PipeStressModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class PipeStressModel extends Object implements Serializable
Three-dimensional pipe stress model of one piping system per ASME B31.3 (Process Piping).

The pipe is modelled as 3D Euler-Bernoulli beam elements (six degrees of freedom per node) in a global frame with z up. At every change of direction the model inserts a long-radius bend: the two short tangent elements next to the corner get the B31.3 bend flexibility factor k = 1.65/h, and the bend nodes get the stress intensification factor i = 0.9/h2/3 with h = T R / r2 (applied to the resultant moment, conservative for the out-of-plane part). Nodes joining three or more elements are treated as welding tees (h = 3.1 T / r).

Restraints: anchors (rigid or with given nozzle stiffness), one-way rest supports (+z only, can lift off) with Coulomb friction, guides (rest support plus a bilateral horizontal stop across the pipe) and axial line stops. The operating case is solved by iterating the support contact and stick/slip states until they no longer change.

Load cases (B31.3 para. 319 and 320, liberal allowable of Eq. 1b):

  • OPE: weight + thermal expansion, nonlinear supports with friction;
  • SUS: weight + pressure with the support contact found in OPE (sustained longitudinal stress SL <= Sh, corroded wall);
  • EXP: OPE minus SUS (displacement stress range SE <= SA = f (1.25 (Sc + Sh) - SL), nominal wall);
  • OCC: horizontal acceleration (seismic) and wind in x and y, combined with SUS (SL + Socc <= 1.33 Sh).

Results include displacements, code stresses with SIFs at every element end, the internal-pressure wall thickness check (B31.3 para. 304.1.2), support loads and states, and anchor (nozzle) loads checked against vendor allowables when given. Units are SI: metres, newtons, pascals, degrees Celsius.

    • updateContact

      private boolean updateContact(double[] u, Map<PipeStressModel.Restraint,PipeStressModel.SupportState> states)
      Active-set contact update: release the most tensile support or close the most penetrated gap, one per call.

      Changing one support at a time avoids the chatter that occurs when several neighbouring supports switch together. A small hysteresis (1 N tension, 1 micrometre penetration) stops round-off from toggling a support.

      Parameters:
      u - displacements
      states - support states
      Returns:
      true when a support changed state (re-solve needed)

    • updateFriction

      private boolean updateFriction(double[] u, Map<PipeStressModel.Restraint,PipeStressModel.SupportState> states, List<double[]> xyz, List<PipeStressModel.Element> els, boolean freeze)
      Update stick/slip state and friction forces of supports in contact.

      A stuck support starts to slide when its horizontal reaction exceeds mu N; a sliding support carries mu N opposite to its movement (relaxed 50 % towards the new value) and sticks again when it no longer moves. After half the outer iterations the stick/slip pattern is frozen and only the friction forces are updated, which guarantees termination.

      Parameters:
      u - displacements
      states - support states
      xyz - node coordinates
      els - elements
      freeze - true to keep the stick/slip pattern
      Returns:
      true when friction states or forces changed
